key_concepts: A pulse is a single disturbance that travels along a rope when one end is moved up and dow
Continuously vibrating one end of a rope creates a traveling wave
A ribbon attached to a rope or slinky acts as a marker showing how a segment of the medium
Transverse waves have crests and troughs
Amplitude is the maximum displacement of a wave from its rest position
Wavelength is the distance between successive crests or successive troughs
Longitudinal waves have compressions and rarefactions
Compression is the region where coils of a slinky are close together; rarefaction is where
Period is the time for one complete wave cycle while frequency is the number of cycles per
